info.title: PowerChain Copilot API
info.description: Canonical HTTP API for PowerChain Copilot 1.0.0. Public API traffic uses the versioned /v1 surface and X-Api-Key client authentication. User/workspace operations additionally require the signed HttpOnly session cookie. The web application calls a same-origin /api/v1 gateway that injects the server-side API key; browser code never receives the key. AI and network responses do not constitute approval, dispatch, financial advice, transaction confirmation, or settlement evidence.
info.summary: Governed SaaS API for PowerChain Copilot renewable-infrastructure operations.
